verdict.rationale: Vast.ai exposes a REST API/CLI with 'programmatic control over the entire platform' and has a Teams feature for organizing members, plus billing/autobilling docs, suggesting some usage/billing data could be pulled and teams could be attributed. However, no evidence documents a specific billing/usage-breakdown endpoint, report, or per-team/workload cost attribution capability. missing for 10: explicit billing/usage API endpoint documentation, evidence of per-team or per-workload spend breakdown, sample billing report output.
